notes: Loaded from Wikipedia (1973 Grand Prix motorcycle racing season); 11 championship Rounds plus the Nations Grand Prix, whose 500cc race was cancelled and which stays in the numbering as a Non-championship round (Round 4), so the Rounds are numbered 1 to 12. Counting window: best 6 of Rounds 1-12. Charlie Sanby (3rd at the Isle of Man) is excluded from the championship and has a Points override of 0. Needs a hand check against motogp.com.

rounds.name: Nations Grand Prix
rounds.notes: The 500cc race of the Nations Grand Prix at Monza was cancelled after the deaths of Jarno Saarinen and Renzo Pasolini in the 250cc race (the 1973 season article): no points were awarded. The Round keeps number 4, so the later Rounds are numbered 5 to 12.

rounds.name: Isle of Man TT
rounds.notes: Most of the top contenders boycotted the Isle of Man TT over safety concerns (the 1973 season article); the Round still counts. Charlie Sanby finished 3rd but is excluded from the championship final standings because he held only a domestic licence: his Points override is 0, and the Riders behind him are not promoted (the official table gives 4th place Alex George 8 points).

sessions.notes: Charlie Sanby finished 3rd but is excluded from the FIM championship final standings (domestic licence only): Points override 0, nobody behind him promoted.

rounds.name: Yugoslavian Grand Prix
rounds.notes: The MV Agusta, Suzuki and Harley-Davidson teams sat out the Yugoslavian Grand Prix over safety conditions at Opatija (the 1973 season article), so it was won against a reduced field. It still counts.
